cohort: 4118 women with HIV infection who were treated with lopinavir/ritonavir during pregnancy and delivered between 2003 and 2012 in the United Kingdom/Ireland
finding: Lopinavir/ritonavir-containing ART regimens in pregnant women with HIV infection were associated with good safety profiles, effective viral suppression, and low rates of MTCT.
mod_finding: 63% of deliveries were by caesarean section (6% elective, 38% emergency).
